shelters.name: Nevada Humane Society
shelters.description: Incorporated 1932, only open-admission no-kill shelter in Nevada. Provides care to over 20,000 animals annually including dogs, cats, rabbits, and small animals. Campuses in Reno and Carson City.

shelters.name: The Animal Foundation
shelters.description: Helps 20,000+ animals annually find safety, healing, and love. Offers adoption, veterinary care, emergency pop-up pet food pantries, and essential resources.

shelters.name: Nevada SPCA
shelters.description: Since 1982, Southern Nevada's original no-kill animal shelter. Independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit supported by community donations. Walk-in adoptions with low fees.

shelters.name: SPCA of Northern Nevada
shelters.description: Leading advocate for animal welfare. Offers affordable spay/neuter services, vaccination and microchip clinics, pet surrender assistance, and behavior help.

shelters.name: Las Vegas Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: Nonprofit organization dedicated to rescue of sick, injured, and homeless animals in Southern Nevada.

shelters.name: Pet Network Humane Society
shelters.description: Based near Lake Tahoe, enables pets and people to connect and thrive. All animals leave microchipped, dewormed, spayed/neutered, and vaccinated.

shelters.name: Henderson Animal Protection Services
shelters.description: Animal Protection Officers, shelter staff, and veterinary team reuniting lost pets, providing medical care, and handling adoptions.

shelters.name: Crazy4Pawz
shelters.description: Foster-based nonprofit animal rescue in Henderson saving unwanted and abandoned pets, educating public on pet care, and stopping backyard breeding.

shelters.name: Las Vegas Rescue Center
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit saving homeless and abandoned dogs and cats. All animals spayed/neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped before adoption.

shelters.name: Forgotten Dogs Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Honored March 20, 2024 as Forgotten Dogs Animal Rescue Day by Las Vegas Mayor and City Council. Rescues neglected animals into foster homes.

shelters.name: Nevada Humane Society - Carson City
shelters.description: Carson City campus of Nevada Humane Society providing adoption, rescue, and low-cost veterinary services to the capital area.

shelters.name: Carson Tahoe Pet Network
shelters.description: Animal rescue serving the Carson City and Lake Tahoe region with foster-based rescue programs.

shelters.name: Lied Animal Shelter
shelters.description: One of the largest single-site animal shelters in the nation, operated by The Animal Foundation serving the Las Vegas community.

shelters.name: Best Friends Animal Society Nevada
shelters.description: National organization with Las Vegas location providing rescue, foster programs, and community outreach to help make Nevada no-kill by 2025.

shelters.name: Animal Rescue Foundation of Nevada
shelters.description: Animal rescue foundation serving the Reno area with adoption and rescue services.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Nevada animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Nevada Humane Society (incorporated 1932) is the only open-admission no-kill shelter in Nevada, serving 20,000+ animals annually. The Animal Foundation helps 20,000+ animals annually in Las Vegas. Coverage spans Las Vegas, Reno, Henderson, Carson City, and Lake Tahoe area.
